english.note: Use this when the person seems weighed down by worries or preoccupied with personal troubles.

examples.english: Ming has been angsty lately and won’t say what’s wrong when I ask.
examples.traditional: 阿明呢排成日心事重重，問佢咩事都唔肯講。
